title: Once in jail for chasing women
summary: Howard says he was once jailed for running around with women and jokes about settling down.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You went through this whole life, and only got in jail one time, didn't you?
They put you in jail once?
Yeah, they had me in jail one day (laughter). Down here--you know, on what's-er-name street.
(inaudible) mistaken identity or something, because you wouldn't do anything wrong, would you? (inaudible)?
No, I had been chasin' around with some chicks, you know. I had no business doin' it (laugh).
(laugh) That surprises me when you say it.

Huh? You ain't surprised at me; I'm still a man, like everybody else. And only thing about it is if--keep foolin' around--If I can just settle myself down, like you do--you don't do nothin' (laughter)
If I can just settle myself down, why, I'll be all right.
